title: Onboarding accelerator: visual walkthrough and interactive quantize/batch controls
creator: Aisha Patel
body: Design task to produce a compact onboarding/quickstart flow for the Optimize toolkit that demonstrates batching, KV-prefix caching, and the quantization recommendation UI. Deliverables: a set of 6 annotated screens (desktop + responsive variants), an interactive prototype for the quantize slider and batch simulator (Figma prototype), copy for tooltips and microcopy, and a screenshot pack for the Console release notes and docs site. The goal is to make the economic trade-offs tangible: show latency vs cost vs quality, and provide a safe default path plus a path for advanced tuning. This ticket covers visual design, microcopy, and final asset export; engineering will implement interactions in a follow-up ENG ticket. Avoid reusing existing quickstart hero patterns; introduce a small simulation panel (batch size, prefix cache hit rate) that updates an estimated tokens/sec and $/100k tokens line. Include a compact modal for "Apply recommended profile" with confirmation and brief changelog text for audits.
acceptance_criteria: Six annotated Figma screens (desktop + mobile variants) uploaded to Optimize Toolkit file
Interactive Figma prototype demonstrating quantize slider and batch simulator with three preset recommendations (Safe, Balanced, Aggressive)
All microcopy reviewed and signed off by PM (Lena Rodriguez) and Eng lead (Priya Gupta)
Exported screenshot pack: 3 hero images (1200x600), 4 in-page thumbnails (600x300), and one animated GIF for release social
A11y checklist completed (contrast, keyboard nav for prototype) and documented in comments
Link to a single GitHub PR that wires copy/alt text into docs repository or release note draft
tasks: Draft exploratory sketches for simulator panel and recommendation row
Design high-fidelity screens for: onboarding flow, tutorial tooltip, quantize modal, batch simulator panel, apply-confirm dialog, success toast
Write microcopy for tooltips, learn-more links, and CTA variations
Build Figma prototype and add simple interactions (slider + preset buttons + metric readout)
Coordinate with PM to lock recommendation presets and numbers
Export image assets and handoff tokens/spacing to engineering
Publish assets to Drive and link PR in comments
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha: Kickoff — sketched three approaches for the batch simulator: (1) stacked cards showing latency/cost, (2) a tiny live chart, (3) single-line metric readout. Leaning to approach 3 for compactness in onboarding.
2026-03-04 - Marco: Mockups uploaded (v0.1). Feedback from PM: numbers for presets need to be grounded in runtime data. ENG suggested ENG-2173 will provide perf numbers by 03/08.

2026-03-08 - Priya Gupta (Eng): Provided baseline metrics from canary runs attached to ENG-2173. Recommended safe preset: no quant, batch=1; balanced: q4f16, batch=4; aggressive: q4f8, batch=8. Added note about KV cache hit simulation accuracy.

2026-03-10 - Lena Rodriguez (PM): Reviewed copy; suggested simpler CTAs: 'Apply preset' and 'View details'. Also requested an audit trail line in the apply-confirm modal: 'Profile applied by <user> on <date>'.
2026-03-12 - Marco: Updated prototype (v0.3) with presets wired to the slider, added animated metric readouts, and exported initial screenshot pack. Marking ready for design review tomorrow.
2026-03-12 - Aisha: Requesting design review meeting invite with PM/Eng for 2026-03-13. Added accessibility checklist and contrast notes to comments.
